# Arcanite source and attribution

Upstream: https://github.com/katelouie/arcanite
Pinned commit: c025b97c49e564e16019cafba381375fd1697a17
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Kate Louie; full notice in LICENSE.

cards.json combines the 78 files from src/arcanite/cards/json/tarot without changing their card fields. upstream-engine.py is a preserved reference copy, not an executed dependency. Local Node code adapts the catalog and deterministic assembly approach. Russian editorial meanings and position text are original project material, not a claimed verbatim translation of the upstream meanings. Card rank normalization uses stable card_id instead of inconsistent upstream card_number fields for three court cards.

No Python packages, hosted API or optional LLM provider are required by the sandbox.
